issues: Pre-existing recharts width(-1)/height(-1) container warnings (documented iterations 10–13, unchanged) — non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: roommaster_service.validate_payload correctly rejects check_in >= check_out with strict d1 < d2, and rejects non-ISO dates before touching Mongo. Good.

roommaster_service.process_webhook upserts into `reservations` on unique reservation_id, preserving `id` and `received_at` on update — safe for Stage 1 CSV coexistence. Downstream analytics/scoring untouched.

server.py:3573 raises HTTPException(400, detail=result) for validation failures — this returns the full result dict as `detail`. Tests pass because we look at status_code and lowercased body text, but if a consumer expects `detail` as a string they'd have to json-parse it. Non-blocking — cleaner would be `detail=result.get('reason')` and put the full dict in a JSON body via JSONResponse.

inbox_service.send_reply persists an outbound record EVEN when Resend returns an error, and marks the original 'Replied'. But server.py:3690 raises HTTPException(400) when result.ok is False — so on the sandbox-domain error path the API returns 400 to the caller AFTER the outbound/Replied side-effects have already been committed. That is functionally OK per the spec, but the 400 response body doesn't include the outbound message id, so a UI that wants to render the failed outbound has to refetch the thread. Consider returning 202 + body when the DB write succeeded but the send failed.

inbox_service.list_inbox silently drops the q filter when len(q.strip())<3. Tests confirmed. UI must know to keep the input debounced OR strip is fine — either way, behavior is 'no results filter' rather than an error, matches spec.

notifications_service.emit_inbox_notification is called synchronously from inbox_create inside the request handler — an errored Resend call in a downstream retry could delay the response. It's wrapped in try/except so at worst a notification is skipped. Fine for now.

APScheduler uses in-process AsyncIOScheduler tied to the FastAPI event loop. Under multiple uvicorn workers/replicas this WILL run the job N times a day (one per replica). Production deploy should either (a) run on a single-worker scheduler pod, (b) use a distributed lock, or (c) migrate to a dedicated scheduler. Not a bug for the preview environment but worth noting for Stage 9+.
pricing_service.suggest_season line 39 uses `m == 1 and day <= 31` which is 'always true in Jan' — intended but reads awkwardly; consider `m == 1` for clarity.

pricing_service.upsert_cell recomputes `season` when patch omits it, always calling suggest_season(day) even if user explicitly set a non-standard notes-only edit — but since it's default-argument fallback that's OK. `created_at` correctly preserved on update.
server.py:3898 pricing_bulk_import uses `async for p in db.properties.find(...)` — motor supports this pattern; works correctly. Nothing to change.

roommaster webhook route is registered on `app` (not `api`) at /api/roommaster/webhook — matches spec (JWT-free, guarded by header only). Path is hardcoded '/api/roommaster/webhook' so it works even though `api` router isn't mounted for it.
NotificationBell polls every 60s via setInterval — good. Unmount cleans up. Bell is unconditionally rendered in Layout sidebar footer + mobile bar, so staff also sees it (spec-correct).
